notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hi, 

A small patch to increase stability, adding various failsafes when code (especially sounds and music) can fail. Also decreased lifetime of some projectiles to improve global performance. 

Thanks and keep Ohjatin' !

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello, here again with a small update containing a potential fix for the end game bugs like the boss not dying properly. I also added a version number in the settings to keep track of the bugs in each version.
You can contact me on the discord if you have any issue or crash, and I will try to fix it asap.
Thank you all and keep Ohjatin' !

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hi !

Just a hotfix to fix an end-of-run issue where the game would not end after killing the boss. We also did a number of hotfixes during the weekend to prevent crashes as much as possible. If you have any crash / bug be sure to let me know I will fix it as quick as possible. We also appreciate feedback ! 
Thank you and keep Ohjatin'

notes.title: Ohjata release !
notes.content: Hello and thank you for buying the game ! We are excited to see what are your experiences in this harsh and challenging game. We want to inform you that a player has had a crash and we're currently investigating. Expect a hotfix soon, and don't hesitate to contact us for any bugs or crashes. Thank you all !
